prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip, and it already shows this exact alley and the root-arch gate. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[Generation Goal] 6 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The night-shadow wolf chases Mai FAST down the dusk alley: a handheld camera rides right behind the wolf's HEAD (only its head is in frame), the gate is already NEAR, Mai is already STANDING at the gate, looks back at the big shadow wolf, then runs into it, and the wolf keeps sprinting after her. Mai's SCALE matches @Video1 exactly.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this alley-with-root-gate location. @Image1: the alley, this IS the street (two rows of narrow tube houses with balconies, roller shutters, utility poles and sagging overhead wires); relight it as DUSK after rain: wet asphalt with long reflections, a purple-grey evening sky, one warm street lamp on the right side, cool shadows. @Image2: what lies INSIDE the gate: a cyan-teal tunnel with floating glowing monitors; seen through the arch as a bright teal glow. @Image3 = MAI ONLY (design only, re-render in Mai's 3D style): girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack. @Image4 = THE NIGHT-SHADOW WOLF ONLY: copy its design EXACTLY as in the sheet: the same lean, long-legged wolf silhouette, the same tall pointed ears, the same jagged spiky crest along the back of the head, neck and spine, the same narrow muzzle and two small glowing yellow almond eyes. It is a living NIGHT SHADOW, exactly like the sheet: the whole body is filled with one solid, flat, deep black, like ink or a cast shadow; the spiky crest is part of the OUTLINE SHAPE only (sharp black points of shadow), not furry texture: no visible fur strands, no fluffy volume, no grey or brown tones, no 3D shading, no highlights inside the silhouette. The outline edges dissolve slightly into thin wisps of plain black smoke.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style for every character and creature: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 and of Mai as she appears in @Video1. The character reference images are DESIGN ONLY (face shape, hair, costume, colours, props); many of them are drawn in other styles (pencil sketch, watercolour, flat 2D, outlined illustration, paper texture): IGNORE their drawing style completely and never copy outlines, sketch lines, watercolour washes, flat shading or paper grain. Re-render every person as a 3D character from the same film as Mai: the same proportion system and stylisation (rounded soft volumes, slightly large expressive eyes with catchlights, small nose, simplified features), the same skin shading and subsurface warmth, the same cloth and hair materials, the same lighting response, film grain and level of detail. Adults stay adult proportions (7-7.5 heads) but share Mai's stylisation. Nobody may look like a different art style, a 2D drawing, a realistic human or a different film. The wolf is the one exception: it keeps the night-shadow look of its sheet @Image4: a flat solid black silhouette, not a 3D-modelled furry animal.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person and 1 wolf in this clip; nobody else exists: no pedestrians, no other animals, no crowd.
1. Mai (@Image3): already STANDING right at the gate from the first frame, about 8 metres in front of the camera, about one third of the frame height (scale as in @Video1); then she runs into the gate.
Plus: 1 night-shadow wolf (@Image4): ONLY ITS HEAD, ears and the spiky crest on its neck are in frame, BIG in the left foreground; the rest of its body is behind the camera and never seen.

[Scale Lock, match @Video1] Mai and the gate keep exactly the real-world scale they have in @Video1: Mai is a small 11-year-old girl about 1.4 m tall (6-6.5 heads); the root-arch gate is NOT gigantic: its opening is only about TWICE Mai's height (about 3 m tall) and it spans the width of the narrow alley from house wall to house wall, exactly like the arch Mai stands in at the start of @Video1; the roller shutters and ground-floor doors are taller than Mai; the wolf is HUGE, much bigger than a real wolf: its shoulders would stand taller than Mai, its head alone is about as tall as Mai's whole upper body. On screen Mai is never a tiny dot: from the first frame she is a clearly readable full figure about ONE THIRD of the frame height, with her backpack, bob hair, skirt and sneakers readable, and she grows to about HALF the frame height as the wolf closes in.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image3) and the night-shadow wolf (@Image4) are completely separate; Mai keeps only her own school uniform and backpack; the wolf is a solid flat black shadow silhouette exactly like its sheet, with no clothing and no human features.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] Handheld camera at the wolf's head height, 35 mm, held tight just behind and slightly right of the wolf's head: ONLY THE WOLF'S HEAD is in frame: the back of its BIG flat black shadow head, its two tall pointed ears and the jagged spiky crest running down its neck (the silhouette of @Image4), solid black with no inner detail, fill the LEFT 40% of the frame from the bottom edge up to above the middle, in the foreground, slightly out of focus, seen from behind as it looks down the street; its edges smoke softly. The frame cuts off at the wolf's neck: its shoulders, back, hindquarters, rump, legs and tail are NEVER visible; the wolf's body is entirely behind and below the camera. The camera is already NEAR THE END of the wet, reflective street: the root-arch GATE is only about 10 metres ahead, centred, and from the first frame it fills roughly the middle half of the frame width; it is a round arch of twisted black roots and vines spanning the narrow alley wall to wall, its opening (about twice Mai's height) filled with bright cyan-teal light (@Image2). Houses with roller shutters line both sides close to camera; a warm street lamp on the right sidewalk; utility poles and sagging wires against the purple dusk sky above the arch. From the first frame Mai (@Image3) is already STANDING right in front of the arch, one step from its threshold, in the centre of the frame, about one third of the frame height, a clearly readable full figure silhouetted against the teal opening, half-turned and looking back over her shoulder at the wolf. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-6 s), 1 person visible (Mai, at the gate) + only the wolf's head in the foreground: ONE fast forward HANDHELD tracking move that keeps pace with the sprinting wolf, keeping the same composition the whole time and STOPPING just before the arch (the camera never enters the gate; it ends still outside, framing the arch): the camera is hand-held and has a slight, natural handheld shake (small irregular bumps and micro-sway synced with the wolf's strides, light and controlled, never chaotic, the horizon stays level). The wolf sprints FAST down the middle of the wet street in a quick, urgent gallop: only its big shadow head is seen, bobbing and lunging forward with each rapid stride in the left foreground, the spiky crest and thin wisps of plain black smoke streaming backward; the shutters and house walls rush past on both sides noticeably fast, puddle splashes of rippling smoke flick up at the bottom edge of frame; 0-1.5 s: Mai (@Image3) stands at the arch, looking back at the charging wolf, startled; 1.5-4 s: she turns and runs the last light steps under the root arch into the teal glow, growing toward half the frame height; the arch grows to fill most of the frame as the wolf closes distance, but the wolf never reaches her; at the end Mai disappears into the bright teal light while the wolf's head is still lunging toward the arch threshold.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not fast and not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; moderate speed.

[Villain Look] Every villain, night-shadow person and shadow creature is plain darkness: a flat, solid NEUTRAL BLACK silhouette like an ordinary cast shadow, no colour tint, no volume, no form shading, no surface detail, no highlights inside the body. NO glow, NO aura, NO halo, NO coloured outline or rim, NO purple, violet or indigo light, haze or particles around or inside them; nothing emanates from them. Any smoke from them is plain black smoke, never glowing.
[Eyes] ALL night-shadow people, villains, shadow creatures and the BOSS have NO PUPILS: each eye is a small flat almond shape filled with ONE uniform glowing colour from edge to edge. NO black pupil, NO dark dot, NO slit, NO iris ring, no eye detail at all inside the glow.

[Acting] The wolf: relentless, predatory and FAST, a quick urgent rhythm of strides with real weight, head pushing forward. Mai: frightened, small, hurrying, one quick glance back. Classic animation principles: anticipation, follow-through on the trailing smoke, Mai's hair and backpack, real weight.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Restrained; Mai's face is too small to read; no screaming.

[Lighting] Dusk after rain: purple-grey sky, a warm orange street lamp on the right, cool blue shadows, strong teal glow pouring out of the gate and reflecting down the wet street toward the camera, the wolf's head stays a flat PURE BLACK silhouette that the light does not model, even when the teal glow hits it (no rim highlights, never turns grey or pink); light haze in the air.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: rapid heavy shadow footfalls and a rushing whoosh of smoke, fast ghostly panting, a low growl, Mai's light quick footsteps close ahead, a deep humming whoosh from the glowing gate, dripping water, faint distant city hum. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] Mai tiny or far away, a giant gate much taller than two Mai heights, a long empty street between camera and gate, the camera entering the gate or the tunnel; the wolf head turning grey, pink or lit; the camera passing through the arch; the wolf's shoulders, back, body, hindquarters, rump, hind legs or tail visible; a full-body wolf; a slow trot or loping wolf; a smooth gimbal or locked-off camera; violent shaky-cam, whip pans, heavy motion-blur smear, a tilted horizon; mixed art styles, 2D or sketch-like characters, realistic photographic humans; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, signs or logos anywhere; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; the camera changing angle or crossing to the other side; the wolf catching, biting or touching Mai; the wolf stopping; teeth, fangs, blood; pupils, black pupils, dark dots in the eyes, slit pupils, irises; purple, violet or indigo glow or aura on the wolf; a realistic animal, fur, hair strands, fluffy or shaggy coat, furry texture, soft fluffy tufts, fur strands on the ears or neck, a fur-textured edge, a dark brown or grey wolf, a 3D-modelled wolf head with light and shading on it, a small wolf, a wolf that looks different from its sheet, Mai far from the gate or running a long distance, detailed muzzle, 3D-shaded wolf body, visible muscles; a second wolf, other people, pedestrians, cars; daylight, blue sky, sunny street; a mirrored layout; the gate on the side of the street; athletic or sprinter running for Mai, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
